items.title: The Last of the Druids Microtransactions Are Now Available in Store
items.excerpt: Microtransactions from the Last of the Druids Mystery Box have finally been released in the store for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2! From Armour Sets to Portals and Level-Up Effects, there are over 60 new microtransactions available, giving you even more ways to customise your Exile and show off your style. Check out the full selection in the store, or watch the video below to take a closer look at everything included in the Last of the Druids Mystery Box. Thank you for your support!

items.title: Path of Exile 2 ExileCon Qualifier #2 Is Going On Now!
items.excerpt: The ExileCon Path of Exile 2 Qualifier #2 is happening now! Who will join Jiluo in the finale at ExileCon this November? Watch the action live at https://www.twitch.tv/pathofexile! Co-streaming is welcome. Twitch Drops are now available for 24 hours, until 2 PM PDT on August 14. Watch the official broadcast or any channel streaming Path of Exile 2 for 30 minutes during the race, or catch up with your favourite content creator afterwards, to receive the Lightbringer Hood. For more details about the event, check out the announcement here. Good luck to all participants!

items.title: Path of Exile 2 at gamescom 2026
items.excerpt: Path of Exile 2 will once again be heading to gamescom in Cologne, Germany. Play a special demo available exclusively at the event, snap some photos with our eerie display, and pick up exclusive merchandise. We'll be sharing more details closer to the event, and we hope to see you there! items.title: Path of Exile 2 Build Showcase: Frogmancer by Yuzo TV
items.excerpt: If you've ever wanted to solve your problems with an unreasonable number of exploding frogs, this build may be exactly what you're looking for. Doedre's Undoing is a Lineage Support Gem that transforms curses into areas of cursed ground. While enemies standing within these areas become cursed, the real attraction is that they also begin spawning Witchtoads. These amphibious allies leap toward nearby enemies before exploding in a burst of Chaos damage, making them the true stars of the build.
